def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    rot_cw=lambda a:[list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    rot_ccw=lambda a:[list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    rot_180=lambda a:[row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    return [
        row[:]+rot_cw(grid)[i] for i,row in enumerate(grid)
    ] + [
        row[:]+rot_180(grid)[i] for i,row in enumerate(rot_ccw(grid))
    ]
